description: This source file defines the 'DelegatedCommandSenderImpl' class, which implements the 'DelegatedCommandSender' interface. It provides functionalities to send command messages via AMQP using Vertx-Proton, including creating command messages, managing tracing spans, and handling delivery outcomes within a messaging client context.

classes.name: DelegatedCommandSenderImpl
classes.description: Implementation of DelegatedCommandSender that handles sending delegated command messages over AMQP, including span management and delivery outcome handling.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for the outcome, optionally with a parent span context.

methods.name: sendMessageAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Internal method to send a message and wait for its delivery outcome, with span tracing.

methods.name: sendCommandMessage
methods.description: Creates and sends a delegated command message, managing tracing spans and tagging.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new DelegatedCommandSender instance with the specified connection, tenant, device, and close hook.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the target address string for sending delegated command messages based on tenant and device IDs.

methods.name: startSpan
methods.description: Starts a new tracing span for the delegated command request, with validation of tracer presence.

methods.name: createDelegatedCommandMessage
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the original message and sets the reply-to address.
